mutationReplay: Required Idempotency-Key on product, cart and wishlist mutations. Principal/operation scope, normalized input hash, atomic mutation/audit/receipt. Identical retries return the original status/body for 30 days; changed input returns 409. Authentication and quotas still apply to replays.

ingestion.key: Required Idempotency-Key, 1-128 letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen. Scoped to principal and operation; normalized request hash conflicts return 409.
ingestion.acceptance: 202 follows majority commit of job, outbox and audit. Identical replay returns the same jobId and acceptance receipt, even if the job is now terminal. GET gives current status.
ingestion.transport: SQS Standard at-least-once, visibility 60 seconds, max receives 5, source retention 4 days, DLQ retention 14 days. ElasticMQ lacks retention enforcement; cloud startup validates it.
ingestion.replayRetention: No automatic job/outbox deletion. Terminal keys remain replayable until a separately reviewed retention migration exists.
ingestion.reconciliation: Leased outbox send-before-mark; overdue nonterminal sent jobs are republished after 5 minutes. Reserved product ID, product effect and completion commit together.
ingestion.authorization: Only administrators accept and redrive. Status is visible to job owner or administrator. Redrive of a failed job increments generation once, preserving productId.

refreshConcurrency: One compare-and-swap succeeds. Reuse or a concurrent loser revokes the family and returns 401. Reauthenticate after a race.
revocation: Requests authorized before revocation may finish. Requests beginning after majority revocation must fail a linearizable primary session check.
totals: Filtered totalItems is exact; unfiltered totalItems is estimated. totalItemsExact identifies the mode.

trust.clients: Body role and forwarded IP headers grant no authority. Signup creates users only.
trust.administrators: Role is read from Mongo on every request. Grant roles only through an authenticated audited operator procedure; no public role mutation route exists.
trust.cache: Redis cannot authorize. Nginx response caching is disabled.
trust.storage: Session and audit collections require restricted deployment credentials. Refresh credentials are stored only as SHA256 hashes.
